As part of our Luxembourg team you will be performing below key duties. Key duties: Serving as a Relationship Manager for a diverse portfolio of Luxembourg companies Assisting with the client acceptance and compliance process Organizing the incorporation of Luxembourg companies Dealing with daily corporate and administrative matters Reviewing transaction documents, corporate secretarial matters, participation in board meetings and drafting related minutes Requirements In addition to indisputably high ethical standards and autonomy, the ideal candidate possesses the following: Degree in Law Experience in liaising with investment bankers, lawyers, investment managers, prime brokers, custodians and other transaction parties located in various international jurisdictions At least 6+ years of experience in a similar role gained in Luxembourg, ideally in financial services company Strong legal documents drafting experience Excellent communication skills Experience in reviewing transaction documents and knowledge of corporate governance, relevant Luxembourg laws and regulatory requirements Fluent English Benefits & Rewards The most enduring professional relationships are reciprocal relationships.
